title: 1890 House

services.name: School Tours
services.desc: The 1890 House Museum loves school groups! Consider a visit to the museum as part of your American history curriculum. Admission is $5 for students, teachers, chaperones, and/or bus drivers. Request information at info@the1890house.org. The 1890 House Museum offers a unique view into life in the late Victorian era. It tells the story of the Industrial Revolution, family life, and showcases the architecture of the period. The 1890 House was the Wickwire family’s home from 1890-1973. During the tour, you will explore the house to see how people lived, how they furnished their home, and how they dressed, entertained, and played. You will also hear stories of the industrial revolution,
